topic: Ek fat cat jo har jagah sota rehta hai aur funny situations mein phasta hai - comedy
character: Guddu Phattu | enormously round belly-up fat orange tabby cat with darker orange stripes, huge mismatched googly eyes (one big blue one small yellow), tiny button pink nose always twitching, oversized droopy jowls, stubby legs barely visible under belly, fluffy curved tail always curled like a question mark, wearing a wrinkled tight tiny red Hawaiian shirt with yellow flowers and saggy purple shorts held up by one suspender, constant drool trail from side of mouth, default half-asleep drowsy expression with tongue lolling out sideways, runs in chaotic spinning cartoon wheels with legs blurring while body stays completely round rolling like a bowling ball, gets stuck in doorways and furniture mid-sleep, falls asleep in impossible places like inside fridges and washing machines | absolutely convinced he's a ladies' man and karate expert but accidentally sleep-flips into trash cans, karate-chops his own tail thinking it's a snake, and snores so loud he creates mini earthquakes that knock over entire buildings
visual_style: Tom and Jerry 2D cartoon animation style
